pageTypes.note: A prospect row names its page in the script of its name link: NewWindow("../newprospects/OpptyDetails.aspx?lDID=<deal>&lPID=<person>&Loc=…"). The page is opened by that address in a second work tab (not by clicking, which opens a pop-up window) and read whole: every label and value, every table as a list. Its structure is saved once per run (inspect_record_customer_…json) to write a precise layout from.

Kendo grid #grid in frame NewProspects/Prospects.aspx?Folder=1 (2 Sold, 3 Inactive, 4 Other); 50 rows at a time, the rest by scrolling; a[href=javascript:RefreshGrid()] reloads. Never pressed: Delete, Merge, Add To List, Unwind.
